user.title: Add a Nanoleaf with an existing token
user.description: For Nanoleaf devices Home Assistant doesn't discover. Enter the device's IP address and an Open API token you already have; it's handed to the built-in Nanoleaf integration, which adds the device as usual.

error.not_nanoleaf: Something answered at that address, but not like a Nanoleaf
error.invalid_token_format: A Nanoleaf token is only letters and digits; check for stray characters
error.handoff_failed: The token is valid, but the Nanoleaf integration didn't add the device: {reason}. Nothing was saved. If this keeps happening, a Home Assistant update may have changed how it takes over tokens; see the log.
error.handoff_in_progress: The token is valid, but Home Assistant already has a setup waiting for this device. Finish or dismiss it under Settings > Devices & services, then try again. Nothing was saved.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach a Nanoleaf at that address (port 16021)

abort.handed_off: Done: {name} was passed to the Nanoleaf integration. Find it under Settings > Devices & services > Nanoleaf.
abort.already_configured: This Nanoleaf is already set up in the Nanoleaf integration
